summary_1line: Cursed Apsaras are freed by Arjuna; he continues pilgrimage, reunites with Krishna at Prabhasa, and is welcomed with honor in Dwaraka.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna drags a struggling crocodile from the sacred waters as it transforms into a radiant Apsara on the shore.
Krishna and Arjuna embrace warmly upon meeting at the sacred region of Prabhasa by the western sea.
Crowds of citizens fill the streets of Dwaraka as Arjuna rides in on a golden chariot beside Krishna.
